Sound credits

Updated 20 November 2026

Mob uses six unmodified Ogg loops from Metiq’s audio assets.

  • Brown, pink, white and grey noise were synthesized by Metiq. See the noise generation source and Metiq’s GPL license.
  • Night crickets is cut by Metiq from AMBIENCE NIGHT FIELD CRICKET 01 by sengjinn.
  • Passing train is cut by Metiq from Train Ambience 3 by Fission9.

The field recordings are credited as CC0 1.0 in Metiq’s audio credits.
